title: Module Hierarchy
description: Design hierarchy produced by mate after the full pass pipeline. Written to debug_output/<module>/hierarchy.json.

dimension.description: A single packed or unpacked array dimension [left:right].

enum_member.description: One member of an enum type.

type.description: Resolved type of a signal or parameter.

kind.description: Base kind: plain integer or enumeration.

width.description: Total bit-width (product of all packed dimension sizes).

packed_dims.description: Packed dimensions, outermost first. Absent when the type is a plain scalar.

unpacked_dims.description: Unpacked dimensions, outermost first. Absent for non-array types.

enum_type.description: Name of the enum type. Present only when kind == "enum".

enum_members.description: All members of the enum. Present only when kind == "enum".

trigger.description: An edge-triggered async signal (clock or reset).

name.description: Name of the driving signal in this module's port list.

signal.description: A resolved input, output, or internal signal.

sync_kind.description: Synchronisation classification. 'sync' belongs to a clock domain; 'clock' is a clock signal; 'reset' is a reset signal; 'async' carries purely asynchronous data.

clock_domain.description: Name of the clock signal that governs this signal. Present only when sync_kind == "sync".

clock_edge.description: Active clock edge for this signal. Present only when sync_kind == "sync".

param.description: A resolved parameter or localparam with its elaborated value.

flop.description: A D-type flip-flop inferred from always_ff logic.

reset.description: Async reset trigger. Absent for flops with no reset.

reset_value.description: Value loaded on reset assertion. Absent when there is no reset.

module.description: A resolved RTL module, including all its ports, internal state, and submodule instantiations.

name.description: Module type name (as declared in the Verilog source).

instance_name.description: Instance name given by the parent. Empty string for the top-level module.

pure_combinational.description: True when the module has no flops and no clock domains (set by io_domains_set from the domains YAML).

parameters.description: Module parameters with their elaborated values.

localparams.description: Local parameters (localparam) with their elaborated values.

inputs.description: Module input ports, ordered as they appear in the source.

outputs.description: Module output ports, ordered as they appear in the source.

signals.description: Internal signals (wires / logic not exposed as ports).

flops.description: All flip-flops inferred in this module (not in submodules).

submodules.description: Directly instantiated submodules, in instantiation order.
